title: sapium glandulatum
intro: Sapium glandulatum, commonly known as the soapberry tree or soapberry, is a plant species that belongs to the family Euphorbiaceae. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, with benefits including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Sapium glandulatum are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
